note: Track C name denylist. Words that survive personal-name validation (NLTagger on iOS, PortableNameValidator on Linux) but must not be bound as a person's name. Two tiers: hard_deny is never a name in any template; ambiguous is a real given name that is also a common English word, so it is accepted only from a STRONG template (explicit E0 bind, 'nice/good to meet/see you', 'this is', 'how are you') and rejected from weak greeting/farewell slots. Rationale and trade-offs: docs/TRACK_C.md.
